meta.name: council
meta.description: Roundtable of ALL active engines — each takes a role, the top-rated engine chairs. `agon council "<decision>"`. Agon's stronger LLM-Council: real heterogeneous models, decision brief, directed critique, a chairman verdict with confidence + kill-switch.

question.description: The decision / question for the council to deliberate.

engines.description: Constrain the panel (comma-separated). Default: all active orchestration engines.

roles.description: Override advisor roles (comma-separated, priority order). Default: Contrarian,First-Principles,Red-Team,Outsider,Expansionist.

chairman.description: Force a specific engine to chair (skips rating-based selection).

json.description: Emit the full CouncilResult as JSON on stdout (pipe-friendly).

label.description: Human-readable suffix baked into the run dir name.
